newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: BB Medtech sells Medtronic stake.
newsitem.headline: BB Medtech sells Medtronic stake.

text.p: Swiss financial holding company BB Medtech AG said it had sold its stake of 320,000 shares, or around 10 percent, in U.S. heart pacemaker manufacturer Medtronic Inc.

The stake, worth around 29 million Swiss francs, was sold in the market during February, a company spokesman said, citing U.S. investment banks' reductions in Medtronic's earnings estimates for the move.
"The funds made available (by the sale) were used to build up a similarly sized stake in St. Jude," BB Medtech said in a statement, referrring to St. Jude Medical Inc.
BB Medtech had more than 400 million Swiss francs in its investment portfolio as of February 25, it said.
